nodes.summary: 10-iteration GUI improvement plan covering code structure, progress bar system, error handling, i18n, and theme improvements. Priority fixes: tokio runtime panic (line 518), progress bar loop semantics (10000 threshold), cancel_flag unused.
Completion status report for GUI improvements. Phase 1 (cancel_flag pause mechanism) and Phase 4 (history record lock optimization) completed. All 293 tests passing.

5-phase performance improvement plan. Phase 1 (Smart Retry P4), Phase 2 (Linear Merge P1'), Phase 3 (HEAD Cache P2), Phase 4 (Pool Config P0'), Phase 5 (Dynamic Threads - abandoned). Expected 30-50% total improvement.

GUI code structure refactoring: extract SharedState to state.rs, progress to progress.rs, handlers to handlers.rs, migrate theme/i18n. Target structure under src/gui/ with mod.rs, state.rs, window.rs, progress.rs, handlers.rs, theme.rs, i18n.rs
FIXED: tokio runtime panic at src/gui.rs:518 - root cause was std::process::Command used in async context. Fix: replace with tokio::process::Command
Progress bar loop semantics clarified: storage format percent*100.0 (0-10000 range), termination condition should be progress < 10000 not progress < 100
cancel_flag was set but never checked in download logic. Implemented pause/resume functionality in Phase 1.
FIXED: History record lock optimization - merged two consecutive history_clone.write() calls into single lock, eliminated redundant drop() calls
P1' priority: Segment merge optimization - current O(n×m) seeks problem. Solution: sort segments by offset then write sequentially, eliminating all seeks. Expected 10-20% improvement.
P4 priority: Smart retry mechanism with differentiated backoff - RateLimited (60s+ Retry-After), ServerError (exponential up to 8s), NetworkError (standard exponential). Expected 5-10% improvement.
P2 priority: HEAD request result caching with 5min TTL, hash-based cache key with user_context to prevent poisoning, LRU eviction. Expected 10-15% improvement on repeated downloads.
P0' priority: HTTP connection pool configuration fix - use builder pattern with shared_with_pool_size(), add 64 connection cap to prevent resource exhaustion. Expected 5-15% improvement.
ABANDONED: Dynamic thread adjustment due to security DoS attack surface, architecture layer coupling, and redundancy with website_profile. Not recommended.

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: x_videos-dowloads is a Rust video downloader supporting x.com/Twitter, TikTok, Douyin, Bilibili, and ZhiXueYun. It provides both CLI and GUI modes with a three-tier parsing chain: ResolverRegistry routes URLs to platform-specific resolvers, yt-dlp handles most platforms, and Scrapling provides Cloudflare bypass as a fallback. The project uses async streaming with reqwest/tokio, parallel segment downloads, and supports P2P collaboration for distributed downloads.

tour.title: Entry Point (CLI)
tour.description: src/main.rs is the CLI entry point using clap for argument parsing. It defines the Cli struct (lines 41-149) and DownloadMode enum (lines 152-162). The main workflow starts with the run() function (lines 247-332) which orchestrates video info fetching and downloads. Key entry functions include: download_with_ytdlp() for yt-dlp downloads, download_with_native() for direct downloads, and download_direct() for simple URL-based downloads. Configuration is managed through AppConfig from src/config.rs.

tour.title: Core Download Flow
tour.description: The core download engine in src/downloader.rs implements VideoDownloader with async streaming and parallel segment downloads. Key methods: VideoDownloader::download() (main entry with retry and fallback to parallel), VideoDownloader::parallel_download() (adaptive thread control with progress reporting), VideoDownloader::do_download() (single-threaded streaming), and VideoDownloader::merge_segments() (offset-ordered segment merging). The HeadCache struct caches HEAD request results with 5-min TTL. src/yt_dlp.rs wraps the yt-dlp executable with AntiBotConfig for anti-crawler measures.

tour.title: Platform Resolvers
tour.description: Platform-specific resolvers implement the PlatformResolver trait (src/resolvers/mod.rs). The ResolverRegistry dispatches URLs to the appropriate resolver: TikTokResolver, DouYinResolver, BilibiliResolver, ZhiXueYunResolver, or falls back to YtDlpResolver. Each platform resolver handles authentication tokens and cookies. Notable components: X-Bogus signature (MD5+RC4 for Twitter), A-Bogus signature (SM3+RC4 for Douyin), CookiePool for session management, and DouYinApiClient for direct API access. The resolvers layer includes xbogus.rs, cookie_pool.rs, and douyin_api.rs.

tour.title: GUI (Slint)
tour.description: Slint-based GUI implementation in src/gui.rs and ui.slint. The run_gui() function (lines 367+) initializes the Slint app window with history, tokio runtime, and callbacks. Key components: SharedState struct holds URL, cookie, output_dir, video_info, and batch state; UrlProgress tracks per-URL download progress with atomic progress/speed arcs. UI is defined in ui.slint with progress bars, history list, and theme management (src/theme.rs). Theme support includes DARK_MODE toggle and AppColors/CardStyle. Progress bar storage uses percent*100 format (0-10000), UI divides by 100.

tour.title: Collaboration P2P Module
tour.description: Peer-to-peer collaboration system for distributed downloads. Core types in src/collaboration/types.rs: Team, Device, Task, TaskStatus. Crypto layer includes AuthToken and HashRing for device coordination. Discovery via DiscoveryService with STUN for NAT type detection. WebSocket client (CollaborationClient) manages ConnectionState and messaging; server (WsServer, MessageHandler, Session) handles peer coordination. File transfer: ChunkedDownloader for parallel segment downloading, FileServer with RateLimiter and CorsAllowList for HTTP serving. LocalQueue maintains offline task queue.

tour.title: Testing
tour.description: The project has a comprehensive test suite. Testing infrastructure includes: types tests (src/types.rs: lines 11, 38, 199, 239, 260, 328, 368, 435, 454, 496, 514, 528), history tests (src/history.rs: lines 10, 20, 58, 73, 147, 157). The GUI improvement plan (docs/plans/gui-improvement-plan-v2.md) reports 293 tests passing after Phase 1 and Phase 4 completion. Performance tests are tracked in docs/plans/performance-improvement-plan.md covering smart retry, segment merge optimization, HEAD caching, and connection pool configuration. Known issues and fixes are documented in HANDOFF.md and CLAUDE.md.
